review_questions: Are all R1, R3 and R4 MODIFY findings prospectively closed while all reviewed snapshots remain immutable?
Does exact rational edge generation match the frozen floor reference without repeated rounded-period addition?
Is the complete seven-field EventIR key used deterministically, with Phase 2 validation as an explicit trusted precondition?
Are dependency, capacity, bridge, queue, deadlock and Zeno semantics deterministic and fail-closed?
Does REPLAY_VALIDATE avoid inventing Phase 4 compute, memory, copy or interconnect completion timing?
Are unsupported Phase 4 resources and ROUND_ROBIN rejected rather than assigned implicit behavior?
Do checkpoint serialization and restore bind all contract hashes and reject corruption, conservation drift and clock-remainder drift?
Does checkpoint identity cover the complete canonical body and do restore invariants cover event/state, waiter/state, trace/state, counters, terminal state and time monotonicity?
Are max_events, max_same_time_events and max_wait_for_nodes enforced at every relevant boundary using bounded traversal?
Does holder conservation use non-wrapping arithmetic across the complete unsigned-128 range?
Does the public fresh constructor reject preloaded waiters while checkpoint restore uses a distinct private reconstruction path?
Does max_same_time_events count each blocked or completed transition, including every waiter completed inside one release step?
Can every accepted checkpoint be reconstructed as an exact deterministic scheduler prefix from reverse-derived initial resources?
Is a transition-limit failure state-atomic and self-restorable, and are FAILED checkpoints explicitly non-resumable?
Do normal, sanitizer and Python-binding evidence all bind the same source root?
Are model, benchmark, GPU, profiling and calibration claims absent?
